info.name: Student Information API Laboratory
info.description: Run against a freshly seeded database. Set password to your local SEED_PASSWORD. Run folders in order. Positive and negative requests assert expected status. The assigned instructor encodes each subject grade and administrators retain oversight; the registrar has no grade access but keeps the read-only transcript. Academic records add a computed GWA that is never submitted by a client. Subsequent runs create additional synthetic records.
